card.name: Device and product name endings
card.fires_on: Fires on 'attached' after 'dose counter', and on the last piece of product or device names such as CLINITEST, FOLLISTIM AQ, prefilled syringes and single-dose autoinjectors.

modes.label: Dose counter attached
modes.description: The word 'attached' (or the 'to' after it) following 'dose counter' in inhaler descriptions.
modes.example: ProAir Digihaler inhaler has a dose counter<< attached>> to the actuator.

modes.label: Inside product names
modes.description: The closing piece of a brand or device name, such as CLINITEST, FOLLISTIM AQ or syringes.
modes.example: using CLINIT<<EST>> ® , Benedict’s Solution, or F
